archetypes.name: dyn-calibration-corpus
archetypes.rationale: Resolver and windowing mistakes can silently use the wrong committed run-log corpus.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new voter calibration snapshot path in python/voting.py and its callers in agent_voters.py and plan_review_panel.py. Focus on consumer repo log-root precedence, run-directory grouping, manifest timestamp ordering, env window handling, and stale snapshot prevention. Check that malformed or old logs fail open without blocking voter dispatch. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-waterfall-prompts
archetypes.rationale: Per-tool prompt_files alter launch-time behavior across fallback phases.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/agent_waterfall.py plus code-review and plan-review manifest writers. Verify prompt_files validation, phase-1/phase-2/phase-3 prompt selection, missing prompt drop behavior, and legacy prompt_file compatibility. Pay special attention to code-review no_fallback=False and plan-review no_fallback=True launch-tool enumeration. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-feedback
archetypes.rationale: Calibration advice must stay advisory and tool-local in rendered voter prompts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review rendering.py and the snapshot read/write helpers for prompt stability and data isolation. Confirm no feedback block appears without a matching base tool and usable severity data, that body_severity is not exposed, and that the block sits after the severity rubric without changing existing prompts when stats are absent. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
